attempts.before: SHL's TICAP (total assets less cash less goodwill less non-interest-bearing current liabilities, proxied here by trade payables where fuller detail is unavailable) can be computed at fiscal year-ends from FY2018 to FY2026 where data exists. At September 30, 2018, total assets of €19,758 million less cash of €519 million less goodwill of €8,176 million less trade payables of €1,278 million give TICAP of €9,785 million. At September 30, 2019, total assets of €21,429 million less cash of €920 million less goodwill of €8,590 million less trade payables of €1,403 million give TICAP of €10,516 million. At September 30, 2022, total assets of €49,056 million less cash of €1,436 million less goodwill of €19,061 million less trade payables of €2,315 million give TICAP of €26,244 million. At September 30, 2023, total assets of €46,684 million less cash of €1,642 million less goodwill of €18,118 million less a broader set of non-interest-bearing current liabilities (trade payables, contract liabilities, current provisions, current income tax liabilities and other current liabilities totaling €8,691 million) give TICAP of €18,233 million. At September 30, 2025, total assets of €44,370 million less cash of €2,175 million less goodwill of €17,124 million (no non-interest-bearing current liabilities detail available for FY2025) give TICAP of €25,071 million. At September 30, 2026, total assets of €46,707 million less cash of €2,542 million less goodwill of €17,477 million (no non-interest-bearing current liabilities detail available for FY2026) give TICAP of €26,688 million. Because the non-interest-bearing current liabilities component is inconsistent across years (trade payables only for FY2018, FY2019, FY2022; a broader set for FY2023; omitted for FY2025 and FY2026), the resulting TICAP figures and any ROTIC built on them are not strictly comparable year to year.
